editDescription: Update this system's code and filter components.
addDescription: Define a system code and the filter components it's built from.
editComponentDescription: Update this filter's name, quantity, and replacement interval.
addComponentDescription: Add a filter, its quantity, and replacement interval.
addAtLeastOneComponent: Add at least one filter component
pageDescription: System codes and the filter components each one is built from.
noSaleListOrdersLinked: No sale-list orders linked to this system yet.
noRepairsLinked: No repairs linked to this system yet.
deleteSystemDescription: This will permanently remove this system code and its component list. Any sale-list orders linked to it will keep their existing data but lose the link.
deleteComponentDescription: This will permanently remove it from this system's component list.
